title: Walks that fail in the full sweep
goal: The scripted walks are the app driving itself, and some of them no longer reach what they were written to check. Find out what each failing walk is looking for, then either fix the app if the walk is right or update the walk if the app moved on. This serves the focus because the sweep is the only thing that tells a focus runner whether the change it just made broke anything: a sweep with failures nobody has named cannot say that, so every focus feature ships on a weaker claim than it should.

digest 2026-10-16: added a checklist item. Four walks this week (framing-a-zoom, two zoom walks, and probably most of today's six) broke because they click fixed window points and d3826b57 moved the timeline.

BROKEN (app fixed): timeline-pinch-both-ways-walk and timeline-pinch-direction-walk. Since d3826b57 a pinch growing the rows with a clip picked changed pickedTimelineRow.height, which read as a pick opening rows and scrolled the timeline to reveal the picked row, so the row under the pointer drifted. pickedTimelineRow now measures at compact rows (EditorState+TimelineZoom.swift).

BROKEN (app fixed) and WRONG: find-what-stayed-a-picture-walk. Wrong: 'expect row Text 3 present false' could no longer mean out of sight once the Layers list filled its pane (398297ad) and kept rows built; now 'expectInView Text 3 out true' (new harness claim), with a positive expectInView before the scroll. Broken: LayersListView never reported the Find a layer field as chrome, so in the pane the list ran 33pt past the pane foot, hiding the selection count line and cutting a picked row by 3pt (seen in the -sc capture). Fixed by measuring the field into the extras the dock budgets.

WRONG (walk rewritten): a-click-on-the-zoom-bar-frames-it-walk and zoom-bar-scrolls-at-the-edge-walk clicked window y 897, which since d3826b57 is the V1 clip (1fb74e4d moved two sibling walks by hand and missed these). box-pick-by-hand-walk started its box on the strip under the tracks, now scrolled out of the shorter timeline; it now starts on the empty Title track at 0.5s. All three aim by lane through the new windowDrag fromLane/toLane and windowClick lane forms, never at fixed points.

TIMING, nothing changed: section-fold-motion-walk and view-to-edit-on-a-long-recording-walk each pass twice on their own (sweep failures were a 22.7ms pass and a 100.4ms freeze against a 100ms bar). Every owned walk passed twice in a row on its own on 2026-10-16; 37 layers-list and timeline walks rerun green; 13,313 tests green. Commit f7afb552.
left rough: many other walks still aim windowDrag/windowClick at fixed timeline points. They pass today, so no task; move each to fromLane/lane when it next breaks.
